title: Heartless
lyrics:
[00:00.00]I don't care about what you have to say at all
[00:04.16]I don't care about your destiny or your life
[00:11.43]And I don't care about all the things you did for me
[00:16.21]I don't care if I am breaking your heart with this song
[00:27.21]'Cause a heartbreaker starts with a broken heart
[00:33.22]And I'm broken, then run, girl, just run
[00:39.35]Don't try to fix me, run away, don't waste your time with me
[00:45.11]'Cause a heartbreaker starts with a broken heart, without hope
[00:52.68]I'm not faking any feeling tonight
[00:57.13]I said everything to you but you're still here with me
[01:04.34]Maybe someday I will be, again, the way I was
[01:08.79]But for now I don't really care if you are here or not
[01:17.30]'Cause a heartbreaker starts with a broken heart
[01:25.44]And I'm broken, then run, girl, just run
[01:31.75]Don't try to fix me, run away, don't waste your time with me
[01:37.44]'Cause a heartbreaker starts with a broken
[01:44.40]I don't need your time, your love, or anything from you
[01:50.83]This is just a fucking waste of time
[01:55.44]Take your chance and run away, or don't you realize?
[02:02.74]It's too late to try to save me
[02:10.77]'Cause a heartbreaker starts with a broken heart
[02:16.44]And I'm broken, then run, girl, just run
[02:22.52]Don't try to fix me, run away, don't waste your time with me
[02:28.49]'Cause a heartbreaker starts with a broken heart, without hope
